name: Alder Ford Toll-Bow

bonuses.4: Ranged attacks against targets in water or mud deal +15% Damage

lore: Worn by the river-wardens who guarded the crossing tariffs between Thornwick and the northern border tracks before the garrisons mutinied.

name: Wayshrine Hedgemage

bonuses.4: Casting a bolt spell restores 6 Mana when standing still

lore: Assembled by wandering border tutors who traded weather-charms and literacy lessons for dry barn lofts along the Redwater.

name: Sunken Dike Sentinel

bonuses.4: Taking poison damage grants +8 Armor for 6 seconds

lore: Forged for the penal battalions ordered to hold Redmarsh's crumbling earthen dikes against bog-beasts and heretic raiders alike.

name: Quicklime Parish Sexton

bonuses.2: +20% Minion Max HP and +16 Spell Damage
bonuses.4: Your raised minions leave a toxic cloud on death

lore: Garments of the grim Redmarsh grave-keepers who learned that burying corpses in wet peat only invited them to walk again.

name: Bitter-Root Fen-Doctor

bonuses.4: Healing potions also grant +15% Spell Damage for 8 seconds

lore: Worn by quarantine physicians who braved the fever-wards of Redmarsh long after royal magistrates abandoned the province.

name: Breakwater Boarding Corps

bonuses.4: Blocking a melee hit deals 18 physical damage back to the attacker

lore: Standard heavy kit of the Ironcamp cliff-marines who repelled corsair landing craft along the jagged basalt coves.

name: Shingle-Reef Smuggler

bonuses.4: Dodging an attack grants +15% Attack Speed for 4 seconds

lore: Favored by Iron Coast wreck-scavengers and smugglers who navigated razor-sharp sea-cliffs under cover of winter squalls.

name: Cliff-Ossuary Tide-Caller

bonuses.4: Summoning a minion chills nearby enemies for 3 seconds

lore: Relics of the solitary cliff-hermits who bound drowned mariners to guard the coastal ossuaries against pirate grave-robbers.

name: Pyre-Marshal's Executioners

bonuses.4: Melee attacks ignite enemies for 24 fire damage over 3 seconds

lore: Forged in the royal gunpowder foundries for the Sovereign's inner-wall shock troops during the final siege of Crown and Ember.

name: Sovereign Hearth-Archon

bonuses.3: +16% Spell Critical Chance and +35% Fire Resistance
bonuses.4: Fire spells reduce target Fire Resistance by 15% for 5 seconds

lore: Vestments of the capital's high court pyromancers, who reduced entire rebellious districts to vitrified glass on royal decree.
